title: Energy output performance of aluminized explosive containing Al/PTFE reactive materials
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,34348-34355
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA01476F, Paper

Fan Jiang, Peipei Sun, Yufan Bu, Yulei Niu, Yuanyuan Li, Kun Zhang, Xiaofeng Wang, Hai Nan
The QSP and equilibrium temperature characteristics of CL-20 based explosive containing Al/PTFE with different ratios and microstructures were studied. Combined with analysis of the explosion products, the reaction mechanism of Al/PTFE was obtained.
